entries.content: After `pnpm run build` + `./scripts/deploy-local.sh --fix`, current OpenCode session still uses cached plugin code; live ADV tool validation requires restarting OpenCode/plugin host. Source tests can pass before live tool behavior changes.

For cross-project incident verification, typed read-only `target_path` ADV tools can confirm recovered release state without mutating target project: `adv_gate_status` on PokeEdge `neutralizePricingDtos` showed release done/incomplete []/archived context after recovery.

Advance source hotfixes should normally start as tracked ADV changes before PR work. Emergency ad-hoc hotfixes are acceptable only with a follow-up issue/change that validates source behavior, rebuild/deploy/restart boundary, incident cleanup, and process decision.
